name: CTA – newsletter
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose CTA – newsletter.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Captcha site key
settings.how: Advanced: enter the existing metafield key or content field key described below. Match the spelling exactly and use the data type expected by this section. Use manual content first if no matching definition exists. This is an optional external integration. Configure the corresponding service first; the setting does not provision a service or guarantee delivery. Public site keys must be restricted to the intended domain. Native Shopify forms remain available without this integration.
